computer.antos.piston_push.tip.basics.bo: Push blocks onto every pressure plate to clear the level. Pushing a row of blocks moves the whole row, but nothing can be pushed into a wall. Press U to undo a move and R to restart.
computer.antos.piston_push.tip.slime.bod: Pushing a slime block drags every block touching it, and blocks behind it follow. If any of them would hit a wall, nothing moves. A plain block pushed away from slime leaves it behind.
computer.antos.piston_push.tip.ice.title: PACKED ICE
computer.antos.piston_push.tip.ice.body: A single block pushed onto packed ice slides until something stops it or it reaches normal floor or a plate. Groups of blocks never slide, and neither do you.
computer.antos.piston_push.tip.honey.bod: Honey sticks to blocks like slime, but honey and slime never stick to each other, so use them to split groups. One push moves at most 12 blocks, or nothing moves.

computer.antos.ore_2048.tip.tnt.title: TNT!
computer.antos.ore_2048.tip.tnt.body: TNT slides like a tile but never merges, and blocks merges across it. After 3 more moves it explodes, clearing the 3x3 around it. Diamond blocks and higher survive the blast. It can free up a full board.

computer.antos.redstone_rush.tutorial.co: ARROWS PAGE  SPACE NEXT  H CLOSE
computer.antos.redstone_rush.tutorial.pi: Pick a tile in the palette by clicking it or pressing 1-4. Right click or Q/E rotates it, and the board previews where it goes. Click an empty cell to place it. Connect the torch to the lamp before the lever runs out.
computer.antos.redstone_rush.tutorial.fl: The signal follows your wire. Light the lamp to win the level. If it reaches an empty cell, obsidian or a tile that doesn't line up, it leaks and the run ends.
computer.antos.redstone_rush.tutorial.po: Power drops by 1 per wire and dies at 0. From level 4 you can pick repeaters (key 4). They reset power to 15, only work in the direction of the arrow and hold the signal one extra step.
computer.antos.redstone_rush.tutorial.cr: Crosses go straight through. Pass one twice for +50. Click an unpowered tile you placed to swap in your selected tile for -25. Powered tiles are locked.
computer.antos.redstone_rush.tutorial.fa: Press F, Space or FLOW to send the signal right away at 8x speed. Tiles it powers after that score double. Each placed tile left unpowered costs 5 when the lamp lights. H opens this help.

Trade with other players, with physical deliveries from the sky.
Browse offers, review seller profiles, and choose how you pay. Reopen this guide anytime with TUTORIAL.

Search by item or seller, filter payments, and use CAN PAY to find affordable offers.
Choose your lots and ONE accepted payment option. Review YOU GIVE and YOU RECEIVE, then confirm the trade.

Choose + LIST, select an item, and set items per lot and the number of lots in stock.
Set item or AntCoin prices, with alternatives if you like. Publishing deposits all stock. Cancel unsold lots from MY TRADES.
computer.antos.merchant.tutorial.3.title: DELIVERIES
Purchases try to arrive nearby automatically. Item payments and returned stock wait in DELIVERIES.
Stand somewhere safe and choose DELIVER HERE. Shipments release loose items on impact. AntCoin payments go straight to your wallet.
